recommendation_reason_words: Joint filing comes out lower: your result is 1,666.72 € jointly and 2,611.92 € individually, a difference of 945.20 €.
individual_branch_caveat: The individual figure is a single return worked out from your whole household's combined inputs, so it is only reliable when one person earns the household's income. It does not work out two separate returns, one on each spouse's own income, and that comparison is not available yet. If two people in your household earn income, read the individual figure as a rough guide, not as the amount to file.
